methodology.cuda_prepare: first process initialization and compile/cache load included in formal job; disk kernel cache retained
methodology.full_scope: 40032 CINE frames, independent two-pixel coordinate gather/calibration, all 3001 Qs, true-time provenance, values/CSV/PNG/SVG, close reader; additional diagnostic npy files also included
methodology.gpu_policy: CPU coordinate gather and /4095; GPU association. Original workbench uses inherited GPU calibration and explicit CPU alignment; production must retain those boundaries.
methodology.excluded: extra warm numerical/kernel diagnostics, parent historical-output validation, report JSON, task registration/atomic publication/source second revision check
methodology.comparison: Historical full GPU run is one observation. Current processor CPU/GPU diagnostics use 31 selected original Qs with W and center fixed; no full-time extrapolation.
methodology.theoretical_limit: Measured attainable reference; not a proof of the theoretical optimum
methodology.timing: Formal job timers stop before warm diagnostics. Individual phase medians are not an additive same-trial total. Kernel event spans a preallocated warmed full-Q launch and is not Nsight activity timing.

profile_diagnostic.note: Instrumented diagnostic only; exclude from timing medians

proposed_acceptance.scope: same source, W10001, 3001 Qs, complete outputs/publication/revision check, warm OS, fresh worker CUDA setup included, 3 serial repeats per policy
